editions.headline: The Accountant Woke Up From His Nap and Carved the Whole Crew Like a Thanksgiving Turkey
editions.teaser: Uncle_Jim turns a lunchtime +$1,284.39 into a record +$10,964.94, beats StankGravy by $4,491.85 and stretches the streak to W5. SlowPonies round-trips $10,668.57 in an afternoon, and XgonGivIt2ya says "Look over your shoulder" from fourth place, down $9,222.31.

editions.headline: Some Guy Named StankGravy Just Walked In and Robbed the Place
editions.teaser: A rookie with zero finished crew comps is up +$6,068.13 by 11:12 AM and jabbing a man with $0.00. Uncle_Jim's four-day streak sits in cash, SlowPonies goes all-in again, and the Hall of Shame is open for business.
